integrity: The normalized moment identity and positive deficit are proved explicitly, including complex equality cases and finite-grid boundary; the exact-arithmetic verification script requires only the Python standard library. This work does not claim independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: Sixth moments and antipodal coordinate spectra only. Finite cyclic transfer requires orders at least seven; order-six optimal constants are not determined. The standalone tests cover finitely many small dimensions and cannot prove the uniform theorem. Priority against the full historical mathematical literature remains subject to independent confirmation.
title: Sharp sixth Fourier moments and a positive deficit certificate for cross-polytope spectra
